name: Daymond Goulder-Horobin
photo_credit: Supplied to policy.nz by the candidate/party

questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: I am running to restore sanity and balance to our Parliament and Government. Our Government is currently rife with insanity, and many are out of touch with the real world. I will prove to the world that we can indeed have a Government that can be relied upon and trusted by the people to protect them from foreign adversaries and the uncertainty of new technology that poses new challenges for our Nation.
questionnaire_2026.About me: I have a wealth of academic knowledge and prowess up to the Masters level. I am not afraid to step out of the party line to voice my real views on election bills. I have the confidence to lead and I value my views and ability to help others. I am different from the rest, support me and the party I fight for and we can get this country back on track.
